ayahs.arabicText: تَبٰرَكَ الَّذِیْ بِیَدِهِ الْمُلْكُ١٘ وَ هُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَیْءٍ قَدِیْرُۙ
ayahs.translation: Blessed is He in Whose Hand is the dominion of the Universe, and Who has power over everything;

ayahs.arabicText: اِ۟لَّذِیْ خَلَقَ الْمَوْتَ وَ الْحَیٰوةَ لِیَبْلُوَكُمْ اَیُّكُمْ اَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا١ؕ وَ هُوَ الْعَزِیْزُ الْغَفُوْرُۙ
ayahs.translation: Who created death and life that He might try you as to which of you is better in deed. He is the Most Mighty, the Most Forgiving;

ayahs.arabicText: الَّذِیْ خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمٰوٰتٍ طِبَاقًا١ؕ مَا تَرٰى فِیْ خَلْقِ الرَّحْمٰنِ مِنْ تَفٰوُتٍ١ؕ فَارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ١ۙ هَلْ تَرٰى مِنْ فُطُوْرٍ
ayahs.translation: Who created the seven heavens one upon another. You will see no incongruity in the Merciful One's creation. Turn your vision again, can you see any flaw?

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ ارْجِعِ الْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَیْنِ یَنْقَلِبْ اِلَیْكَ الْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَّ هُوَ حَسِیْرٌ
ayahs.translation: Then turn your vision again, and then again; in the end your vision will come back to you, worn out and frustrated.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ زَیَّنَّا السَّمَآءَ الدُّنْیَا بِمَصَابِیْحَ وَ جَعَلْنٰهَا رُجُوْمًا لِّلشَّیٰطِیْنِ وَ اَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ السَّعِیْرِ
ayahs.translation: We have adorned the lower heaven with lamps, and have made them a means to drive away the satans. We have prepared for them the chastisement of the Blazing Fire.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لِلَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ١ؕ وَ بِئْسَ الْمَصِیْرُ
ayahs.translation: The chastisement of Hell awaits those who disbelieve in their Lord. What a wretched destination!

ayahs.arabicText: اِذَاۤ اُلْقُوْا فِیْهَا سَمِعُوْا لَهَا شَهِیْقًا وَّ هِیَ تَفُوْرُۙ
ayahs.translation: When they will be cast into it, they will hear it roar as it boils,

ayahs.arabicText: تَكَادُ تَمَیَّزُ مِنَ الْغَیْظِ١ؕ كُلَّمَاۤ اُلْقِیَ فِیْهَا فَوْجٌ سَاَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَاۤ اَلَمْ یَاْتِكُمْ نَذِیْرٌ
ayahs.translation: as though it will burst with rage. Every time a multitude is cast into it, its keepers will ask them: “Did no warner come to you?”

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا بَلٰى قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِیْرٌ١ۙ۬ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَ قُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ اللّٰهُ مِنْ شَیْءٍ١ۖۚ اِنْ اَنْتُمْ اِلَّا فِیْ ضَلٰلٍ كَبِیْرٍ
ayahs.translation: They will say: “Yes, a warner came to us, but we gave the lie to him and said: 'Allah has revealed nothing. You are surely in huge error.'

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالُوْا لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ اَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِیْۤ اَصْحٰبِ السَّعِیْرِ
ayahs.translation: They will say: 'If we had only listened and understood, we would not be among the inmates of the Blazing Fire.'”

ayahs.arabicText: فَاعْتَرَفُوْا بِذَنْۢبِهِمْ١ۚ فَسُحْقًا لِّاَصْحٰبِ السَّعِیْرِ
ayahs.translation: Thus will they confess their sins. Damned are these inmates of the Blazing Fire.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ یَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ بِالْغَیْبِ لَهُمْ مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَّ اَجْرٌ كَبِیْرٌ
ayahs.translation: Surely forgiveness and a mighty reward await those who fear Allah without seeing Him.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَسِرُّوْا قَوْلَكُمْ اَوِ اجْهَرُوْا بِهٖ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلِیْمٌۢ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوْرِ
ayahs.translation: Whether you speak in secrecy or aloud, (it is all the same to Allah). He even knows the secrets that lie hidden in the breasts of people.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَا یَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ١ؕ وَ هُوَ اللَّطِیْفُ الْخَبِیْرُ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Would He not know, He Who has created, when He is All-Subtle, All-Aware?

ayahs.arabicText: هُوَ الَّذِیْ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الْاَرْضَ ذَلُوْلًا فَامْشُوْا فِیْ مَنَاكِبِهَا وَ كُلُوْا مِنْ رِّزْقِهٖ١ؕ وَ اِلَیْهِ النُّشُوْرُ
ayahs.translation: He it is Who made the earth subservient to you. So traverse in its tracks and partake of the sustenance He has provided. To Him will you be resurrected.

ayahs.arabicText: ءَاَمِنْتُمْ مَّنْ فِی السَّمَآءِ اَنْ یَّخْسِفَ بِكُمُ الْاَرْضَ فَاِذَا هِیَ تَمُوْرُۙ
ayahs.translation: Do you feel secure that He Who is in the heaven will not cause the earth to cave in with you, and then suddenly it will begin to rock violently?

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ اَمِنْتُمْ مَّنْ فِی السَّمَآءِ اَنْ یُّرْسِلَ عَلَیْكُمْ حَاصِبًا١ؕ فَسَتَعْلَمُوْنَ كَیْفَ نَذِیْرِ
ayahs.translation: Do you feel secure that He Who is in the heaven will not let loose upon you a storm of stones? Then shall you know what My warning is like!

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ كَذَّبَ الَّذِیْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَیْفَ كَانَ نَكِیْرِ
ayahs.translation: Those who came before them also gave the lie (to the Messengers): then how awesome was My chastisement!

ayahs.arabicText: اَوَ لَمْ یَرَوْا اِلَى الطَّیْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صٰٓفّٰتٍ وَّ یَقْبِضْنَ١ؕۘؔ مَا یُمْسِكُهُنَّ اِلَّا الرَّحْمٰنُ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ بِكُلِّ شَیْءٍۭ بَصِیْرٌ
ayahs.translation: Have they not seen birds above them spreading and closing their wings, with none holding them except the Merciful One? He oversees everything.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمَّنْ هٰذَا الَّذِیْ هُوَ جُنْدٌ لَّكُمْ یَنْصُرُكُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِ الرَّحْمٰنِ١ؕ اِنِ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ اِلَّا فِیْ غُرُوْرٍۚ
ayahs.translation: Which is your army that will come to your aid against the Merciful Lord? But the unbelievers are in utter delusion.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمَّنْ هٰذَا الَّذِیْ یَرْزُقُكُمْ اِنْ اَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهٗ١ۚ بَلْ لَّجُّوْا فِیْ عُتُوٍّ وَّ نُفُوْرٍ
ayahs.translation: Who shall provide for you if He withholds His sustenance? Nay; but they persist in rebellion and aversion.

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَمَنْ یَّمْشِیْ مُكِبًّا عَلٰى وَجْهِهٖۤ اَهْدٰۤى اَمَّنْ یَّمْشِیْ سَوِیًّا عَلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: Who is better guided: he who walks grovelling on his face, or he who walks upright on a Straight Path?

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِیْۤ اَنْشَاَكُمْ وَ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَ الْاَبْصَارَ وَ الْاَفْئِدَةَ١ؕ قَلِیْلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say: “He it is Who has brought you into being, and has given you hearing and sight, and has given you hearts to think and understand. How seldom do you give thanks!”

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ هُوَ الَّذِیْ ذَرَاَكُمْ فِی الْاَرْضِ وَ اِلَیْهِ تُحْشَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say: “Allah it is Who multiplied you in the earth and to Him you will be mustered.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَقُوْلُوْنَ مَتٰى هٰذَا الْوَعْدُ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: They say: “If you are truthful, tell us when will this promise (of the Hereafter) be fulfilled?”

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ اِنَّمَا الْعِلْمُ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ١۪ وَ اِنَّمَاۤ اَنَا نَذِیْرٌ مُّبِیْنٌ
ayahs.translation: Say: “Allah alone knows about that; and I am no more than a plain warner.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَمَّا رَاَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِیْٓئَتْ وُجُوْهُ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَ قِیْلَ هٰذَا الَّذِیْ كُنْتُمْ بِهٖ تَدَّعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: When they will see it near at hand, the faces of all those who had denied it will be distraught, and then they will be told: “This is the doom which you used to ask for.”

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ اَرَءَیْتُمْ اِنْ اَهْلَكَنِیَ اللّٰهُ وَ مَنْ مَّعِیَ اَوْ رَحِمَنَا١ۙ فَمَنْ یُّجِیْرُ الْكٰفِرِیْنَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ اَلِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: Say to them: “Did you ever consider: whether Allah destroys me and those that are with me, or shows mercy to us, who can protect the unbelievers from a grievous chastisement?”

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ هُوَ الرَّحْمٰنُ اٰمَنَّا بِهٖ وَ عَلَیْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا١ۚ فَسَتَعْلَمُوْنَ مَنْ هُوَ فِیْ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِیْنٍ
ayahs.translation: Say to them: “He is Merciful, and it is in Him that we believe, and it is in Him that we put all our trust. Soon will you know who is in manifest error.”

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ اَرَءَیْتُمْ اِنْ اَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَنْ یَّاْتِیْكُمْ بِمَآءٍ مَّعِیْنٍ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Say to them: “Did you even consider: if all the water that you have (in the wells) were to sink down into the depths of the earth, who will produce for you clear, flowing water?”
